foundation: Predicative Calculus of Cumulative Inductive Constructions (pCuIC)

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: elim: n => [| n' ih] //=
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Elimination principle invocation using recursor generated by Inductive definition; ssreflect views connect reflection predicates directly to case analysis.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Prefer case: and elim: with ssreflect intro-patterns and trailing simplifiers //=.
dialect_pitfalls: Forgetting to generalize dependent premises prior to induction
Wildcard naming leading to fragile script breakages
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: induction n with | zero => h0 | succ n' ih => hsucc

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: apply/idP: H
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: MathComp inductive predicate reflect (P : Prop) : bool -> Type with canonical ssreflect views.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Replace Prop-valued connective reasoning with decidable bool predicates and ssreflect views apply/idP.
dialect_pitfalls: Accidental mixing of Prop \/ and bool || causing reflection failure
Stack overflow in vm_compute if terms lack normal forms
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by decide

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: rewrite /def -[t]h1 !lem
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Setoid or Leibniz rewriting with pattern occurrence selection and automatic side-condition discharging.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: MathComp ssreflect rewrite with lock/unlock flags, occurrence indicators {1 3}, and inline simplification //.
dialect_pitfalls: Occurrence matching mismatch when implicit arguments differ
Setoid rewrite failure when Proper instances are missing
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: simp only [add_comm, mul_zero]

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: Structure group := Pack { sort : Type; class : class_of sort }
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Packed classes (MathComp): explicit record telescopes of mixins with Canonical Structure inference via unification hints.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Bundle operations and laws into mixins, then seal the hierarchy behind a single canonical constructor.
dialect_pitfalls: Inscrutable unification failures when canonical projections do not trigger
Boilerplate overhead when extending deep inheritance hierarchies
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: class Group (G : Type u) extends Monoid G, Inv G where ...

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: eauto with mydb or lia
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Depth-first iterative deepening proof search with unification; Fourier-Motzkin and Presburger procedures in lia.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Group auxiliary lemmas into hint databases (Hint Resolve, Hint Rewrite) and invoke auto with ...
dialect_pitfalls: eauto getting stuck in infinite unification depth without progress
Slow compilation of heavy firstorder invocations
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: aesop (add safe ...) or omega

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: have ->: a = b by ...; have ->: b = c by ...; reflexivity.
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: RelationClasses transitivity instances discharged through tactic engine or explicit lemma application.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: MathComp users frequently structure calculation proofs via consecutive rewrite steps rather than explicit calc environments.
dialect_pitfalls: Unification failures on uninstantiated intermediate variables in transitivity
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: calc a = b := h1 _ <= c := h2 _ < d := h3

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: setoid_rewrite h or Instance: Proper (equiv ==> equiv) f.
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Setoid framework based on morphism relation classes (Proper); quotients formed via equivalence classes or axiom of extensionality.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Register congruence relations with Add Parametric Relation and declare Proper instances for all operators.
dialect_pitfalls: Setoid rewriting fails if a single subterm lacks a Proper instance
Heavy term bloat when quotients are modeled as sets of equivalence classes
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Quot.sound (h : a ~ b) or Quotient.lift f h_resp

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: inversion H; subst. or discriminate H.
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Discriminates impossible constructors by constructing discriminant functions into empty datatypes; unifies constructor parameters.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Combine inversion H; subst to immediately simplify equality hypotheses.
dialect_pitfalls: inversion generating massive contexts of redundant equality hypotheses requiring manual subst or clear
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: injection h with h1 h2 or contradiction

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: l a <= b = (a <= u b)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: MathComp order hierarchy formalized via boolean comparison predicates (<=%O).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Leverage boolean reflection on order relations to discharge order inequalities computationally.
dialect_pitfalls: Classical vs constructive differences when handling infinite meets/joins
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: GaloisConnection l u meaning l a <= b <-> a <= u b

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: { x : A | P x } or { x : A & P x }
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Constructive dependent pair datatypes in Type/Set with distinct projection accessors.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use exist (fun x => P x) v h or destructure with let '(exist x h) := s in ...
dialect_pitfalls: Proof irrelevance does NOT hold by default in Coq without importing ProofIrrelevance axiom, making subtype equality proofs harder
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: { x : A // P x } or <val, prop>

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: classic: P \/ ~P
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Pure Coq logic is intuitionistic; classical choice requires importing external axioms (Coq.Logic.ClassicalChoice).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: MathComp avoids classical axioms by relying on boolean reflection over finite/decidable domains.
dialect_pitfalls: Importing classical axioms pollutes constructive extraction to OCaml/Haskell
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Classical.choose (h : exists x, P x) and Classical.choose_spec h

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: Lemma step_preserves_inv : forall s, Inv s -> Inv (step s).
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Inductive relations over operational configurations; termination certificates via measure functions into nat or well-founded orders.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Couple state invariants with inductive trace relations.
dialect_pitfalls: State space explosion when composing parallel processes without abstraction layers
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: theorem invariant_step (s : State) (h_inv : Inv s) : Inv (step s) and V (step s) <= alpha * V s

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: by lia | by lra | by ring
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Micromega certificate checkers (`lia`, `nia`, `lra`, `nra`) and reflective polynomial normalizer (`ring`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `lia` -> `omega`, `lra` -> `linarith`, `nia`/`nra` -> `nlinarith`, and `ring` -> `ring`.
dialect_pitfalls: MathComp `ssrnat` operations (`.+1`, `addn`, `subn`) require `zify` or `nat_norm` before `lia` works cleanly
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by omega | by linarith [h1, h2] | by ring | by positivity

mechanisms.canonical_name: Numeric Coercions, Cast Normalization & Denominator Clearing
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: rewrite !PoszD !mulrz | rewrite divfK //
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Explicit ring morphism rewrites (`intrD`, `natrD`, `PoszD` in `ssrint`/`ssrnum`) and explicit non-zero cancellation (`divfK`, `mulfVK`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Replace `rewrite !intrD !intrM` with `push_cast` / `norm_cast`, and `rewrite divfK //` with `field_simp`.
dialect_pitfalls: MathComp's `Posz` (`n%:Z`) and `_%:R` are explicit functions rather than unified `@[norm_cast]` attributes
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: push_cast; ring | zify [h_le] at *; omega | field_simp [hne]; ring

mechanisms.canonical_name: Well-Founded Recursion, Termination Measures & Functional Induction
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: Equations f (n : nat) : nat by wf n lt := ... | funelim (f n)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Sozeau's `Equations` package compiling well-founded definitions and generating the `funelim` elimination principle.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `Equations ... by wf` + `funelim (f x)` directly to Lean 4 `termination_by` + `fun_induction f x`.
dialect_pitfalls: Avoid legacy `Program Fixpoint` / `Function` when porting; their manual proof obligations map cleanly to `decreasing_by` + `fun_induction`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: def f (x : alpha) : beta := ... termination_by measure x decreasing_by omega | fun_induction f x with ...

mechanisms.canonical_name: Measure Spaces, Lebesgue/Bochner Integration & Almost-Everywhere Filters
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: \int[mu]_(x in D) f x | {ae mu, forall x, P x}
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: MathComp-Analysis `measureType` and Lebesgue integration over extended reals `\bar R` with `measurable` tactic.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `\int[mu]_(x in D) f x` to `∫ x in D, f x ∂μ` (or `∫⁻` for non-negative extended reals) and `{ae mu, ...}` to `∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ...`.
dialect_pitfalls: MathComp-Analysis integrates into `\bar R` (`[-∞, +∞]`), whereas Mathlib splits `∫⁻` (`[0, +∞]`) and `∫` (Banach space `E`)
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ∫ x in s, f x ∂μ | ∫⁻ x, g x ∂μ | ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, P x | filter_upwards [h1, h2] with x hx1 hx2

mechanisms.canonical_name: Big Operators, Finite Sums/Products & Indexed Monoid Folding
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: \sum_(i < n | P i) F i | \prod_(x in A) F x
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Canonical `\big[op/idx]_(i <- r | P i) F i` library supporting monoid laws, index filtering, and partition reindexing.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `eq_bigr` -> `Finset.sum_congr rfl`, `bigD1` -> `Finset.add_sum_erase`, `exchange_big` -> `Finset.sum_comm`, and `| P i` -> `∑ i ∈ s with P i, F i`.
dialect_pitfalls: MathComp's `\big` operates over a list `r` and only uses commutativity/idempotence when `r` is duplicate-free (`uniq r`)
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ∑ x ∈ s, f x | ∏ x ∈ s, f x | ∑ x ∈ s with P x, f x

mechanisms.canonical_name: Bitvectors, Machine Words, SWAR & Bit-Blasting Decision Procedures
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: w : word 64 | by bitblast
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: `coqword` / `Bedrock2` `word.ok` / MathComp `w.-tuple bool` fixed-width word libraries.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate fixed-width `word 64` bitwise lemmas to `BitVec 64` + `by bv_decide`.
dialect_pitfalls: Coq `Z.land` / `Z.lxor` operates on unbounded integers `Z` rather than modular `BitVec w`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by bv_decide | by bv_omega | ext i hi; simp [BitVec.getLsbD]

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: apply/setP => x | apply/ffunP => i | congr (_ + _)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Finitary extensionality views (`setP` on `{set T}`, `ffunP` on `{ffun I -> T}`, `eq_fun` for `=1` pointwise equality) Avoiding the global `functional_extensionality` axiom when possible.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `apply/setP => x`, `apply/ffunP => x`, and `f =1 g` into standard `ext x` in Lean 4 (where `funext` is derived from `Quot.sound` in the standard kernel trust base).
dialect_pitfalls: MathComp uses `f =1 g` (`eqfun`) instead of `f = g` to stay axiom-free in Coq; in Lean 4 `funext` is standard so `f = g` is preferred
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ext x y | funext x | congr 1

mechanisms.canonical_name: Filters, Nets, Eventualities & Topological Limit Convergence
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: f @ x --> y | \near x, P x | near=> n
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: MathComp-Analysis filter convergence `f @ F --> G` and `near=>` tactic for discharging `\near F, P x` eventualities.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `f @ x --> y` to `Tendsto f (𝓝 x) (𝓝 y)` and `near=> n` to `filter_upwards with n hn`.
dialect_pitfalls: MathComp-Analysis overloads `x` and `nbhs x` via canonical structures; in Mathlib write `(𝓝 x)` explicitly in `Tendsto`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Tendsto f (𝓝 x) (𝓝 y) | Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l) | ∀ᶠ n in atTop, P n
